key_insight: Better video captions require prioritizing meaningful visual evidence, not treating every detail equally. Reviso is an agentic framework that learns what to observe and how to gather evidence relevant to each video.
problem_solved: Multimodal large language models can focus on minor visual details while missing essential context and key events, producing detailed but poorly prioritized captions.
method: Treat visual importance as dependent on the content of each video.
Use an agentic captioning framework to learn what visual information to observe.
Gather relevant visual evidence to support caption generation; further implementation details are unavailable in the truncated abstract.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, Reviso points toward content-aware evidence selection as a way to improve video caption relevance. The supplied abstract does not provide quantitative results or efficiency claims.

paper_title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
